title: Backfill Must Not Undo a New Edit
description: During online migration, a new value reaches both shards, then an older historical row is backfilled into the new shard. What protects the new value before read cutover?

options.text: Copy historical rows last and overwrite every destination row.
options.explanation: That lets stale backfill erase a newer dual-written update.

options.text: Switch reads before checking migration progress.
options.explanation: Premature cutover can expose missing or stale data.

options.text: Drop the old shard as soon as the first batch arrives.
options.explanation: The destination is not complete or verified, so removing the source risks loss.

options.text: Apply version checks or safe insert-if-absent backfill, verify convergence, then switch reads.
options.explanation: Backfill must not regress newer writes. Verification precedes read cutover, and the old path is retired only after the migration's consistency conditions hold.
